archive_layout.root: Paths are relative to the original qa-memory directory except experiments/ patches and drivers/package_evidence.py

helpers.class_path_order: Recorded probe classes precede the runtime JAR; helper hashes are separate from the runtime artifact hash

inputs.download_policy: HTTPS only, verified TLS, HTTPS-only redirects

notes: Build bindings describe the build-time state; later measurements do not rewrite them.
CI snapshots preserve their observed PR state even when the PR was merged later.
Input/artifact SHA-256 pins are not output SHA-256 fingerprints.
No build, test, decoder, compiler, benchmark or network request is launched by this script.
